name: nexus-ai-monorepo
description: NEXUS AI - Futuristic Personal AI Operating System & Content Studio

scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace=backend" "npm run dev --workspace=frontend" "npm run dev --workspace=desktop"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend && npm run build --workspace=desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace=desktop
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix desktop
